definitions.gloss: war situation; battle conditions; state of the fighting
definitions.explanation: The current state or progress of a war or battle. Also used figuratively for competitive situations.

examples.japanese: {戦況|せんきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}した→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧。
⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{戦況|せんきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ラジオ→ラジオ：01541_rajio⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{伝|つた}えられた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: The latest battle conditions were reported on the radio.

examples.japanese: {戦況|せんきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不利|ふり}→不利：03603_furi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{指揮官|しきかん}→指揮官：19069_shikikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{撤退|てったい}→撤退：12822_tettai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じた→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧。
examples.english: When the battle situation became unfavorable, the commander ordered a retreat.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (war, battle) + {況|きょう} (situation, condition). Primarily used in military and historical contexts, but can also appear in sports commentary and business contexts to describe competitive situations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦況|せんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to report the war situation
- {戦況|せんきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧: the war situation worsens
- {戦況|せんきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好転|こうてん}→好転：17466_kouten⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the war situation improves
- {戦況|せんきょう}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧: battle situation report
- {戦況|せんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見守|みまも}る→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧: to watch the battle situation unfold

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {戦局|せんきょく}: the war situation — focuses on the overall course and direction of a war
- ⟦{情勢|じょうせい}→情勢：12739_jousei⟧: situation, circumstances — broader, not limited to war
- ⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧: situation, conditions — general-purpose word
- ⟦{戦線|せんせん}→戦線：22999_sensen⟧: front line, battle front — refers to the physical line of fighting
